title: Make the ticket classifier prompt testable
checks: The system message lists all labels and asks for the label only
build_messages('x', [])[0]['role'] == 'system' and all(l in build_messages('x', [])[0]['content'] for l in LABELS) and 'only' in build_messages('x', [])[0]['content'].lower()
Examples become user and assistant turns

[m['role'] for m in build_messages('x', [('a', 'billing'), ('b', 'delivery')])] == ['system', 'user', 'assistant', 'user', 'assistant', 'user'] and build_messages('x', [('a', 'billing')])[2]['content'] == 'billing'
build_messages('Refund please', [])[-1]['content'].count('<ticket>') == 1 and 'Refund please' in build_messages('Refund please', [])[-1]['content']
A ticket cannot close the fence early
[parse_label(r) for r in ('Label: Billing.', '  DELIVERY ', 'technical issue')] == ['billing', 'delivery', 'technical']
parse_label('I think it is about a refund') == 'other' and parse_label('') == 'other'
